newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Lee to withdraw criticism of Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Lee to withdraw criticism of Malaysia.

text.p: Singapore elder statesman Lee Kuan Yew said on Monday he would ask a local court to delete from the record criticism of neighbouring Malaysia which triggered a diplomatic row.

Lee said in a statement he would ask the court to delete comments in an affidavit that Johor Baru, just across the causeway in Malaysia, was "notorious for shootings, muggings and car-jackings," a remark that incensed Kuala Lumpur.
Last week, Lee offered his unreserved apologies for a comment made in pursuit of a libel action against an opposition politician and which he had not expected to be made public.
Malaysia has said its cabinet would discuss the apology on Wednesday amid calls for the Kuala Lumpur government to demand a full retraction.

The word retraction was not used in Lee's statement on Monday. "My counsel will apply to court for permission to delete the offending statements so that they will no longer remain on the record," he said.
